name: GNU grep
blurb: Current GNU grep, replacing a GNV grep that is many releases behind. Includes grep -P with PCRE2 linked in, so the kit is self-contained.

name: GNU sed
blurb: The GNU stream editor, built natively with VSI C and tested against upstream's own suite.

name: GNU awk
blurb: gawk, built with the OpenVMS port that ships inside every gawk release, wrapped in our signed-tarball tooling and PCSI kits.
try: $ gawk "{ n += $2 } END { print n }" SIZES.DAT

name: curl
blurb: Current curl with TLS from VSI's OpenSSL 3 kit, and zlib and zstd linked in for --compressed. Installs as VMSCURL, so it can sit alongside VSI's own CURL kit.

name: GNU Wget
blurb: GNU Wget with HTTPS through VSI's OpenSSL 3 kit and a current CA bundle. It writes downloads as stream files, whatever the old version's record format was.

name: GNU m4
blurb: The GNU macro processor. syscmd and esyscmd run DCL commands through LIB$SPAWN. Bison and flex run m4 to generate their parsers and scanners.

name: GNU Bison
blurb: The GNU parser generator. It runs GNU m4 for OpenVMS to generate its parsers, so the kit requires the M4 kit.

name: flex
blurb: The fast lexical analyser generator, with its LIBFL library and FlexLexer.h. It runs GNU m4 for OpenVMS to generate its scanners, so the kit requires the M4 kit.

name: GNU make
blurb: GNU make, built with the OpenVMS port that ships inside make itself, brought up to date for make 4.4 and VSI C. Recipes are DCL commands.

name: GNU diffutils
blurb: cmp, diff, diff3 and sdiff. "Files differ" is a warning under DCL, so ON ERROR does not stop. GNU diff is gdiff by default, because DIFF abbreviates DCL's DIFFERENCES.

name: GNU patch
blurb: Applies unified and context diffs to your files, with backups, rejects and --dry-run. Pairs with GNU diffutils.

name: GNU gzip
blurb: gzip, gunzip and zcat. VMS text files are compressed as text, so gzip -l agrees with Linux and the .gz unpacks anywhere; gzip -r takes [.dir] as well as Unix names.

name: MariaDB
blurb: The MariaDB 11.4 LTS server and command-line clients, built with VSI's clang compiler. A preview: Aria, MyISAM and MEMORY tables, no InnoDB yet. Installs as VMSMARIADB, beside VSI's own MariaDB kit; VMSMARIADB$CONFIGURE.COM sets the server up as a service under its own account, started at boot and stopped cleanly at shutdown.

name: lighttpd
blurb: A light, fast web server as a modern alternative to VSI's Apache: HTTPS and HTTP/2 through VSI's OpenSSL 3 kit, and PHP as a pool of persistent FastCGI processes; phpBB runs on it with MariaDB, and it can sit behind a reverse proxy that ends TLS. A preview. VMSLIGHTTPD$CONFIGURE.COM sets it up as a service under its own account; it binds ports 80 and 443, then drops every privilege but TMPMBX and NETMBX.

name: PCRE2
blurb: Perl-compatible regular expressions (8-bit, Unicode) as an object library and headers under PCRE2$ROOT. It provides grep -P.

name: zlib
blurb: The zlib compression library as an object library and headers under ZLIB$ROOT. It provides compressed transfers in curl and Wget.

name: bzip2
blurb: The bzip2 compressor and libbz2. VMS text files are compressed as text (their lines survive); the library links with programs compiled with any /NAMES.

name: XZ Utils
blurb: xz, xzdec and lzmainfo with the liblzma library. Reads .xz, .lzma and .lz; passes upstream's own good and bad test files.

name: Zstandard
blurb: The zstd compressor and libzstd: fast compression at any level from 1 to 19, checked against upstream's golden files.
